windows.command: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $outDir = Join-Path $PWD 'assets\img'; if (!(Test-Path $outDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir | Out-Null }; Get-ChildItem 'assets\raw\*.jpg' | ForEach-Object { $name = $_.BaseName; $img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($_.FullName); foreach ($w in @(400, 1000)) { $h = [int]($img.Height * ($w / $img.Width)); $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $h); $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp); $g.DrawImage($img, 0, 0, $w, $h); $suf = if ($w -eq 400) { 'mobile' } else { 'desktop' }; $dest = Join-Path $outDir ($name + '-' + $suf + '.jpg'); $bmp.Save($dest, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Jpeg); $g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose() }; $img.Dispose() }
